nodes.statement: Local D2h-axial pitchfork on the T2g curve (NOTES.md §12)
V_red = V0(mu) + lambda(mu) s^2/2 + c4(mu) s^4/24 + O(s^6), even in s; dV_red/ds = s G(s^2, mu), G = lambda + c4 z/6 + O(z^2); lambda(0) = 0, lambda'(0) = tau, c4(0) = c4
unique local curve mu = mu*(z), mu*'(0) = -c4/(6 tau) > 0; s^2 = -6 tau mu/c4 + O(mu^2); nontrivial equilibria only for mu > 0
cube for both signs; s = +-s*(mu) only for mu > 0; exchanged by N(Sigma) minus Sigma; supercritical in the energy-reduced axial convention
d2V_red/ds2 = tau mu + O(mu^2) < 0 at the cube (mu > 0); -2 tau mu + O(mu^2) > 0 at +-s*
isotropy exactly Sigma; rhombic sections at first order; opposite tetrahedral translation weight n_v; O(s^2) corrections in span{A_HAT, E_HAT}; f_1 component O(s^3)
generic Z2-invariant LS expansion: odd coefficients 0, s^2 coefficient = Schur/2, s^4 coefficient at mu = 0 = (D4V - 3 b^T H^-1 b)/24
B2.0: Sigma = Stab(e_1), order 8; Fix(Sigma) = span{A_HAT, E_HAT, uh_1, vh_1}; the 8 elements of N(Sigma) minus Sigma act on Fix(Sigma) as diag(1, 1, -1, -1)
includes: first-order displacement of s e_1: vertex s moves by -(s n_u/4)(0, s3, s2) - (s n_v sqrt2/4)(s1 s2 s3)(1, 0, 0)
stated in the B0 bases uh_k, vh_k and with the B0 block K (exact definitions used by B2.0)

nodes.statement: B2.1: H|Fix(Sigma) = diag(h_A, h_E) (+) K; c4 = D4V[e_1^4] - 3<b, H_perp^-1 b> = Q - 3 b_A^2/h_A - 3 b_E^2/h_E with <b, f_1> = 0; c4 = q W_q (p - q) c4_hat
includes: the identity's recorded hypotheses: h_A > 0, h_E > 0 (Paper 2 Lemma S, FROZEN INPUT) and tr K > 0 (Paper 2 Lemma T1, FROZEN INPUT), as stated in NOTES.md §6.2

nodes.statement: B2.3 Lemma Q: c4_hat > 0 on the closed T2g curve, hence c4(q) > 0 for 0 < q < q_c (certified; not independently audited)
includes: the corollary c4(q) = q W_q (P_T(q) - q) c4_hat(q) > 0 of NOTES.md §9.1, which uses Paper 2 Lemmas T2, T3 (FROZEN INPUT) as recorded there

nodes.statement: tau = n^T dK/dp n < 0 for 0 < q < q_c on the T2g curve p = P_T(q), where ker K = span{n} (B1.8; independently audited with B1)
includes: Paper 2 Lemmas T1 (tr K > 0) and T3 (unique curve point P_T(q) > q, D_p < 0) and the exact adj identity, as recorded in NOTES.md §5.8

nodes.statement: Lyapunov-Schmidt reduction of an equivariant gradient problem with a one-dimensional kernel (Golubitsky & Schaeffer, Vol. I, Ch. I §3 and Ch. VII; Golubitsky, Stewart & Schaeffer, Vol. II, Ch. XIII)
includes: its hypotheses, checked in NOTES.md §12.2 steps 1-2: V_p is real-analytic in (x, p) near (y*, P_T(q)) (pair distances near 1, sqrt2, sqrt3; r^-p = exp(-p log r)); the O_h action is finite and orthogonal, so grad V is in Fix(Sigma) on y* + Fix(Sigma) (symmetric criticality)

nodes.statement: real-analytic implicit function theorem (Krantz & Parks, The Implicit Function Theorem, Thm 2.3.5)

corroboration_only.statement: B2.4 located branch points, reduced scans, amplitude law (this phase)

statement.name: Proposition B2
statement.scope: fixed q in (0, q_c); mu = p - P_T(q); equilibria of V_p in y* + Fix(Sigma) near y*, |mu| small
statement.coordinate: s = <x - y*, e_1>, e_1 = n_u uh_1 + n_v vh_1, unit n in ker K at mu = 0, n_u > 0
statement.reduced_potential_remainder: O(s^6, mu s^4, mu^2 s^2) with lam = tau mu + O(mu^2)
statement.pitchfork_symmetry: Z2 generated by any element of N(Sigma) minus Sigma (8 elements); (s, wf) -> (-s, -wf)
